jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established manufacturing company with a strong presence in Belgium and an international footprint.

Jobomschrijving

 Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end supply chain activities
• Manage planning, inventory and logistics processes
• Develop and monitor KPIs and performance metrics
• Improve forecasting accuracy and stock management
• Collaborate with production, procurement and sales teams
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives
• Manage suppliers and logistics partners
• Lead and develop the supply chain team

 Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree
• At least 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment
• Proven experience in supply chain management
• Strong knowledge of planning, inventory and logistics
• Experience with ERP systems
• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is mandatory
• Hands-on, analytical and solution-oriented mindset

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

Deze international is gespecialiseerd in de productie en de toelevering van kunststofonderdelen voor de automobielindustrie; spuitgietonderdelen voor voertuigen.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment.

• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation-driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 

• Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.
• Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies. 
• Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic 
• Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures. 
• Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment. 
• Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  
• Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes. 
• Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities. 
• Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

• Associate’s degree or High-School Diploma. 
• You have relevant warehouse experience with a strong affinity to the pharmaceutical environment. 
•  Detail oriented character with a strong affinity to perform administrative work, fill out forms, logbooks, follow regular trainings. 
• You have an ability to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and across different functions. 
• You are a problem solver and have strong analytical and data skills.
• You follow the procedures strictly to ensure both product quality and personal health & safety are followed at all times. 
• Ability to work independently and successfully.
• You speak very good English or Dutch.

European association in Brussels

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the Director General's calendar: schedule meetings, appointments, and events.
• Coordinate internal and external meetings, ensuring all logistics are handled.
• Organize travel arrangements: travel summaries, flights, accommodation, itineraries, and visa requirements. Prepare all necessary documentation.
• Review and prepare briefings, reports, and presentations for internal and external use.
• Ensure the Director General is well-prepared with necessary documents for meetings.
• Organise and attend meetings to take notes and minutes as required.
• Maintain relationships with key stakeholders and manage communications effectively.
• Liaise with all staff to support the DG's preparation for internal and external meetings, participation in events and other engagements, as needed. Liaise with administrative assistants' team to support cross-functional coordination.

• Approximately 20 years experience in a similar function, experience in assisting a C-level 
• You already have work in a sector with EU exposure (to the institutions, EU associations, agencies etc.)
• Excellent organizational skills, with strong control over deadlines, deliverables and time management
• Being proactive
• Being precise and accurate, demonstrating consistency and attention to detail
• Excellent spoken and written English is a prerequisite, any other language is a plus 
• Excellent computer skills (MS office)

Our client is an international BtoB organization operating across multiple countries and known for delivering tailored solutions to corporate customers. In Belgium, the company employs over 100 professionals across two offices and provides a wide range of specialized services. 

To support this strategic ambition, they are looking for an AI Integration Analyst who will play a central role in identifying, implementing, and driving the adoption of AI-powered solutions throughout the organization.

Jobomschrijving

As AI Integration Analyst, you will act as the link between business teams, project management, IT stakeholders, and international AI communities.

Your mission will be to accelerate the practical adoption of AI by identifying high-value opportunities, supporting implementation projects, delivering training and workshops, and helping employees integrate AI tools into their day-to-day activities: AI Opportunity Identification & Business Engagement

• Facilitate workshops with business and IT stakeholders to identify AI use cases.
• Assess and prioritize opportunities according to business value, feasibility, and organizational impact.Translate business challenges into practical AI and automation solutions.
• Support departments in identifying productivity and efficiency gains through AI.

AI Implementation & Project Support

• Coordinate and follow up on AI implementation projects across different business functions.
• Work closely with project managers, data analysts, IT teams, and external partners.
• Monitor project progress, adoption levels, and business outcomes.
• Ensure AI initiatives are aligned with governance, compliance, and security requirements.

Training, Adoption & Change Management

• Develop and deliver AI training sessions, awareness programs, and workshops.
• Promote best practices for the use of AI technologies throughout the organization.
• Drive user adoption through communication, coaching, and continuous support.
• Contribute to the development of the organization's overall AI capabilities and maturity.

International Collaboration

• Collaborate with colleagues and AI specialists from international entities.
• Share knowledge, use cases, and implementation experiences.
• Support the rollout of international AI initiatives at a local level.
• Act as an ambassador for AI-driven transformation within the business.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Proven experience in AI implementation, digital transformation, innovation, business analysis, project management, process improvement, or technology consulting.
• Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging AI technologies.
• Experience working within the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure AI, or similar technologies).
• Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, and enterprise technology environments.
• Experience supporting change management, training initiatives, and technology adoption.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Hands-on technical or programming experience is considered an asset but is not required.
• Good command of Dutch and excellent English communication skills. French would be an advantage but is not required.

Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.
The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
• Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
• Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
• Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

jobs.occupation: HR Assistant & Talent Acquisition - Luxury Fashion - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is an internationally renowned company active in the luxury retail and fashion sector. To support a period of ongoing HR Projects, they are looking for a Talent Acquisition & HR Assistant to reinforce their HR team on a temporary basis for an initial period of 3 to 4 months.

Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic, people-oriented, and collaborative working environment where teamwork, proximity, and flexibility are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

As Talent Acquisition & HR Assistant, your responsibilities will include:

• Managing first stage of the recruitment process (sourcing and prescreening).
• Conducting interviews when required and supporting managers in the assessment process.
• Providing administrative support related to recruitment and HR activities.
• Assisting with employee documentation and personnel administration.
• Supporting the HR team during the implementation of Workday and related HR processes.
• Contributing to various HR projects depending on business needs and workload, including CSR initiatives, process improvements and administrative projects.
• Supporting payroll and HR operations where required.

• You hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
• You have minimum 2 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition and/or HR administration.
• Previous exposure to Workday is a plus.
• You are fluent in French and English. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
• You are organised, proactive and hands-on.
• You enjoy working in a collaborative environment and easily build relationships with different stakeholders.
• You have strong administrative skills and are able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• You are approachable, team-oriented and thrive in a friendly and informal company culture.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team. If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. 

What you can expect: 

• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities.
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

Jobomschrijving

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.

You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

Our client is at the heart of the energy transition as a key player in a sustainable and reliable energy future. This organisation offers a dynamic environment where innovation, impact and technical excellence come together.

Jobomschrijving

As a GL Accountant you will be performing the following tasks:

• Daily accounting entries in AP, AR and GL
• Ensuring accuracy of all data
• Reconciliation of accounts
• Monthly and annual closings for multiple BE entities
• Preparation and analysis of cash flow
• Preparation of the financial statements
• Ensuring compliance with local GAAP and IFRS
• Financial reporting to group
• VAT-declaration and statutory reporting NBB / Intrastat
• Assisting with external audits and internal controls
• Supporting process improvements and automation initiatives
• Acting as a point of contact within the finance team

We are looking for candidates that match the following criteria:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance 
• You bring at least 3 years of relevant experience in accounting, audit or financial reporting.
• Fluent Dutch or French and good knowledge of German and English is a plus
• You possess a strong understanding of BEGAAP, GEGAAP and IFRS reporting standards.
• You are comfortable working in SAP
• You have excellent Excel skills 
• You combine strong analytical capabilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset 
• You are able to work independently, while also being an effective and collaborative team player.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:

• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for: 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.

Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Our client is a leading international logistics group operating within the temperature-controlled supply chain sector. Active across multiple European markets, the company combines operational excellence, strong financial backing, automation, and ambitious growth plans. The environment is dynamic, entrepreneurial, performance-driven, and focused on continuous improvement and innovation

Jobomschrijving

• Define and execute the facilities, maintenance, and engineering strategy across key operational sites.
• Ensure maximum equipment availability, reliability, and operational continuity.
• Lead preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for automated infrastructure and technical assets.
• Manage engineering teams, external contractors, and specialised service providers.
• Develop and monitor maintenance KPIs, budgets, and performance standards.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
• Oversee major capital expenditure projects, site upgrades, and infrastructure investments.
• Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory, and quality requirements.
• Support automation initiatives and technological enhancements across operations.
• Collaborate closely with operations, finance, procurement, and executive leadership teams.

• Extensive leadership experience within logistics, manufacturing, industrial, automated warehousing, cold chain, or similar asset-intensive environments.
• Strong expertise in maintenance management, engineering operations, and technical infrastructure.
• Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and major investment projects.
• Proven capability to manage budgets, suppliers, and performance improvement programmes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication capabilities.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Accounting - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established european organisation active in the financial services sector, with easily accessible offices in Brussels. You will lead a close-knit accounting team within a collaborative environment known for its positive and supportive culture

Jobomschrijving

• Lead, coach and develop a team of two accounting professionals
• Oversee day-to-day general accounting activities and IFRS reporting processes
• Review and validate the trial balance to ensure the accuracy of financial statements
• Coordinate VAT returns, annual accounts and tax compliance obligations

A leading hospitality organisation known for delivering high-quality guest experiences through a diverse portfolio of food, beverage, and events operations.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Food & Beverage your responsibilities are:

• Lead and inspire the Food & Beverage teams, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
• Oversee the daily operations of multiple hospitality outlets and event activities.
• Drive commercial performance through revenue growth initiatives and cost optimisation strategies.
• Manage budgets, forecasts, and full P&L responsibility for the department.
• Analyse operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with culinary and operational teams to ensure consistency, quality, and innovation across all offerings.

• Strong operational expertise managing multiple outlets and/or events activities.
• Demonstrated success in improving commercial performance and profitability.
• Experience managing budgets and full P&L responsibility.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams.
• Hands-on, entrepreneurial, and customer-focused mindset.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
